name: vibespec

scripts.check: node vibespec/spec.ts check && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "fs.chmodSync('dist/spec.js', 0o755); fs.mkdirSync('dist/proof', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('vibespec/proof/lib.dfy', 'dist/proof/lib.dfy'); fs.cpSync('vibespec/studio/public', 'dist/studio/public', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('vibespec/std', 'dist/std', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('vibespec/conformance.ts', 'dist/conformance.ts')"
scripts.prepare: npm run build && node vibespec/spec.ts gen --if-valid

description: Stories, rules and a Quint model in one Markdown file; verified TypeScript out.
